rules.census_row: a row takes the strictest of its charts' partitions: excluded > seen > sealed > validate > tune (v1 ranked the halves above seen)
rules.heldout_p2: official upload, tail pack 'PHOENIX 2', file converts to the map's count
rules.misfit36: extract-loop-2026-09-23 chart whose cached .inset fit pitch is outside 74-77
rules.research_scan: a research file is read when it is a .py/.txt/.json file of at most 20000 bytes naming at most 10 corpus charts (the exact string 'Title Level'); every other file is not read: a listing naming more is a script's output over a population. File names count for video ids.
rules.scorable: p2-official: count-exact by construction; misfit36: exact in sources/corpus-grade.json
rules.seen: chart name, or one of its videos, appears in docs/*.md, tools/*.py, the root *.md, work/loop-buckets-2026-09-26.txt, or a research script/text/<=20KB json or file name
rules.seen_v2: v1's rule, plus: a held-out chart whose title is followed within one phrase by its level token (the phrase starts at the title, runs at most 120 characters, ends at '. ' or '; ' or where another title followed by a level token starts; the title as the corpus writes it, or without its FULL SONG / SHORT CUT / REMIX marker or backslash escapes; case-sensitive), plus every held-out chart on a video that carries a chart named in the scan (any corpus chart) or whose id is named. The scan reads the tracked docs/*.md, tools/*.py and root *.md at 9f8baf6 (the v1 freeze commit, which is what v1 read), the loop proposal, and the same research files as v1.
rules.split: union of song family and video; groups ordered by sha256(salt|min member); each goes to the half with fewer charts of its stratum
